'''Shoon''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Shoon system/Legends|Shoon system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Situated in the area of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] known as [[the Tangles]], it was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Antiquity system/Legends|Antiquity]], [[Osmani system/Legends|Osmani]], and [[Suliana system/Legends|Suliana systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point, Shoon was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a gigantic [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Unidentified Shoon species|species]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]] had disappeared<ref name="TEA" /> by [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of Shoon, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> leaving behind a series of ruins that covered the world. In addition, a terrible yet long-forgotten war was once waged on Shoon, leading to the creation of many rings of [[Magma/Legends|molten rock]] and [[Glass/Legends|glassy]] [[Stone/Legends|stone]] on its surface. Like the other worlds of the Senex-Juvex, Shoon was under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the region.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shoon was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
